note: A rollup, not a new measurement. Every figure here is a sum over the block-level files already shipped, taken over the membership `base/blocks.qc` publishes as `hood` — DataSF Analysis Neighborhoods (ajp5-b2md), 41 polygons. No figure is apportioned and no figure is divided: where a published place stands in a neighbourhood, the whole of its money is reported there, exactly as it is on each of its own blocks.

source.name: Analysis Neighborhoods
source.membership: read from `base/blocks.qc`'s own `hood` field, which is the membership the map draws and the panel already prints. It is NOT re-derived here: a second point-in-polygon pass could disagree with the first and both guards would still pass.

curation.method: dedupe by stem, classify against the tier table, rank by DISTINCTIVENESS x BLOCKS REACHED inside the tier, cap, and count what the cap hid. Distinctiveness is the mean inverse hood-frequency of the line's own words, so boilerplate every neighbourhood's record carries scores 0 and falls; ranking on blocks alone put a sidewalk-assessment hearing at the head of Lone Mountain/USF. Deterministic — no model pass. The lines are the Board's own and every one links to the scan leaf it was printed on.
